zh-CN.title: 工作复盘
zh-CN.goal: 把成果、证据、问题和下一步连起来，方便团队决策。

optionalInputs.question: 复盘的时间范围是什么？
给谁看，他们需要做什么决定？
有哪些目标、实际结果和原始资料？
哪些进展或问题最值得解释？
下一步行动、负责人和期限是否已有安排？

qualityChecks: 用证据时间线或目标对照表组织正文，不堆砌 KPI 卡片。
对已提供的数据做筛选与展开；筛选后总数和叙述同步变化。
未提供指标时保留定性复盘，不编造增长数据或承诺。
zh-CN.missingInformationPolicy: 所有问题均可跳过；使用已有资料，显式列出影响结果的假设，未知事实保留待确认。

en.title: Work review
en.goal: Connect outcomes, evidence, lessons and next steps for team decisions.

optionalInputs.question: What period does this review cover?
Who will read it and what decision do they need to make?
Which goals, actual results and source material are available?
Which changes or problems deserve an explanation?
Are next actions, owners and dates already agreed?

qualityChecks: Use an evidence timeline or goal comparison table, rather than a wall of KPI cards.
Filters and detail expansion must update totals and interpretations together.
Use a qualitative review when metrics are missing; do not fabricate growth or commitments.
en.missingInformationPolicy: All questions may be skipped. Use known material, state consequential assumptions, and leave unknown facts unresolved.
